chuecka89 v2.3 final atom + reconstructed FX preset validation
=================================

Base atom
- SH attack: 30 ms
- SH release: 12 ms
- ECKT delay: 82 ms
- ECKT attack: 0 ms

Core constraints
- ISO C89 compile flags: -O2 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -std=c89
- no malloc/realloc/free in synthesis core
- no float/double in synthesis core
- caller-owned/static storage only
- Q15 fixed-point signal path

Validated targets in this environment
- native GCC static library: build/libchuecka89.a
- Win32 i686 COFF static library via clang/llvm-ar:
  build/libchuecka89_win32.a

Tests
- test_smoke: PASS at 44.1 kHz and 48 kHz
- render_atom_fx: PASS
- render_presets: PASS (all weapon WAVs regenerated with full FX)

New API
- ch89_gesture.effect_flags
- ch89_set_effect_flags()
- CH89_EFFECT_DISTORTION
- CH89_EFFECT_EQ
- CH89_EFFECT_CHORUS
- CH89_EFFECT_REVERB
- CH89_EFFECT_ALL
